warrant: The histories follow anisotropic-electron Weibel growth and the self-consistent Maxwell response. In rt_vlasov_weibel_1x2v_p2.c, alpha (line 89) sets the transverse magnetic seed Bz = alpha sin(kx x) (line 195), while vlasov/apps accumulates the current and advances the Maxwell field. A wrong Vlasov flux, current reduction, field sign or Maxwell update changes the field-energy history at order one. The two-ULP change of alpha is a relative 2.2e-16 change of the seed; the linear stage multiplies seed and perturbation alike, so the relative spread stays at that level until saturation, and the record shows the nonlinear stage lifting it to 3.1e-13 on the electron L2 history by t=80 on the x86 worker (3.98e-13 on the author's arm64): three orders and no more within the window. The strict-IEEE altbuild (same source, gcc -O2, no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native) differs by 3.6e-13. The bound atol=rtol=1e-10, set at review on 2026-09-04, is about 275 times the larger floor, leaving room for a genuinely different arithmetic on the target on a check the survey flags as chaotic.
